author: Brian Hawken
text: also the readings can be wonky first 24hrs.  If it's a new sensor, try "soaking" next one before acivating - put it on 24hrs before current sensor ends BUT DO NOT ACTIVATE until current sensor ends.   When you activate it your body will have acclimated to the new one already and it will start with much more accuracy.  Best of luck.
